# anchor exemplar

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:anchorExemplar`](gmeow-anchorExemplar.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/anchorExemplar>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An exemplar pinned to this anchor's range. NOT functional: several exemplars may calibrate one range.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md) -> [`gmeow:Exemplar`](../classes/gmeow-Exemplar.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:anchorExemplar`](gmeow-anchorExemplar.md) from [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md) to [`gmeow:Exemplar`](../classes/gmeow-Exemplar.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md), [`gmeow:Exemplar`](../classes/gmeow-Exemplar.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to pin an exemplar to a score anchor's range — concrete calibration evidence for what a score means.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single exemplar (it is non-functional — several may calibrate one range).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:anchorExemplar`](gmeow-anchorExemplar.md) from the [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md) to each [`gmeow:Exemplar`](../classes/gmeow-Exemplar.md); the exemplars show the range's meaning by example.

- ex:a1 [`gmeow:anchorExemplar`](gmeow-anchorExemplar.md) ex:ex1.
